newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's TIM denies seeking Wall Street listing.
newsitem.headline: Italy's TIM denies seeking Wall Street listing.

text.p: Italian mobile phone operator Telecom Italia Mobile on Friday denied it was seeking a listing on Wall Street and forecast 1996 pre-tax profits of some two trillion lire.
TIM said in a statement that managing director Vito Gamberale had met investors on Wall Street earlier this week, but denied he had gone to New York to discuss a possible listing for TIM.

The statement said Gamberale told U.S. institutional investors that TIM's 1996 "pre-tax result could be somewhere around two trillion lire, with turnover at about 7.3 trillion lire and an added value superior to 3.5 trillion lire." ((-- Rome newsroom 396 678 2505))
